name: gc2145
src_commit: B15-W3-T2 flip (this commit) — the exact source this artifact was built from; hash pinned in the immediate follow-up commit

entries.desc: abi version gate; returns 2 — the loader accepts {1,2} and this module imports the abi=2 i2c/cam families only (no retired camera_* names)

linear-memory offset for the host-written msgpack args; 0 = refusal; <=128B calls reuse one fixed slot (§3.1); larger bumps return heap_buf-based addresses (P3-T12 rider: the bare-offset era handed out .rodata-range offsets and heap_buf was optimized away)

entries.signature: [{framesize="QVGA"|"VGA"}?] -> {ok, sensor, w, h, ms} | {error, got?, want?}
entries.desc: full bring-up, framesize default QVGA, unknown string = {error='unknown framesize'} BEFORE any hardware touch. Sequence: if a stream is on, cam_stop + >=1000ms settle (100ms slices); cam_xclk(20000000) — XCLK pin 15; 2000ms warmup (20x delay_ms(100) — GC2145 SCCB needs 1-2s after the clock starts); i2c_config(slot0, sda=4, scl=5, 100000) — pins claimed prim=i2c owner=wasm for the module's loaded lifetime; PID probe i2c_writeread {0xF0} then {0xF1} @0x3C (mismatch -> {error='pid mismatch: got 0xXXXX', got, want=0x2145}, no side effects past the probe); SOFT RESET FIRST write {0xFE,0xE0} + 100ms (first-class module knowledge — the vendored esp32-camera camera_probe->reset() path hides it); the 582-pair init table as per-register i2c_write (wire-faithful — GC2145 SCCB has no documented burst auto-increment; the packed 1164B write would fit the 4096B cap but changes wire semantics); 100ms post-table wait; per-framesize subsample geometry deltas (both QVGA and VGA resolve to the 1/2 subsample config of the vendored set_framesize SUBSAMPLE branch — sdkconfig CONFIG_GC_SENSOR_SUBSAMPLE_MODE=y); RGB565 format regs {0xfe,0x00}{0x84,0x06}; cam_start(w,h,0). A framesize switch re-runs the WHOLE sequence incl. soft reset + PID probe. Total ~2.4s of delay_ms inside one call (host cap 15000ms/call is per-call, slices keep the watchdog fed). Host failures (SCCB NACK, slot conflict, cam floor) propagate as the host's wasm exception, class=rt — never swallowed.
cam_stop (host idempotent: stop stream, release the 11 DVP + XCLK pin claims) + module off. Safe before init and when repeated.
cam_frame_info passthrough (host truth: w=h=0, on=0 while off) + module state; framesize = last requested (kept across off, absent before the first init). pixfmt 0 = RGB565.

ops.name: init
ops.result: {ok, sensor, w, h, ms} | {error, got?, want?}
ops.semantics: full bring-up, default QVGA, unknown string = {error='unknown framesize'} BEFORE any hardware touch. Sequence: cam_stop + >=1000ms settle if a stream is on → cam_xclk(20MHz) → 2000ms warmup (100ms slices — GC2145 SCCB needs 1-2s after the clock starts) → i2c_config(slot0, SDA=4, SCL=5, 100kHz) → PID probe (i2c_writeread {0xF0}/{0xF1} @0x3C; mismatch → {error, got, want} carrying the READ pid, no side effects past the probe) → soft reset FIRST (0xFE<-0xE0, 100ms — first-class module knowledge the vendored esp32-camera driver hides in its probe path) → the full 582-pair init table as per-register i2c_write (wire-faithful — GC2145 SCCB has no documented burst auto-increment; transcribed from espressif/esp32-camera 2.1.8, Apache-2.0, guarded by count+hash in the native test) → 100ms → per-framesize subsample geometry deltas (QVGA 320x240 / VGA 640x480, both 1/2-subsample) → RGB565 format regs → cam_start(w,h,0). A framesize switch re-runs the WHOLE sequence (soft reset + PID probe included). ~2.4s of delay_ms inside one call (host cap 15000ms per call; slices keep the watchdog fed). Host failures (SCCB NACK, slot conflict, cam floor) propagate as the host's rt exception — never swallowed

ops.name: off
ops.semantics: cam_stop (host idempotent: stop stream, release the 11 DVP + XCLK pin claims) + module off; safe before init and when repeated

ops.name: info
ops.semantics: cam_frame_info passthrough (ro, no sensor touch) plus the module's last framesize; stream off → w=h=0, on=0, pixfmt 0=RGB565

linear_memory.note: default 4 pages: ~4KB used (582x2 .rodata table + out 2048 + heap 512 + args 128 + io 4 + wasm-ld 64KB stack). Static allocation only — WAMR builtin malloc unavailable (heap_size=0, B12-T1 lesson).

hardware.bus: SCCB 7-bit 0x3C on i2c slot 0, SDA=4 SCL=5 @ 100kHz
hardware.register_knowledge: transcribed from espressif/esp32-camera 2.1.8 (Apache-2.0; public upstream); pairs+comments verbatim, guarded natively by count 582 + FNV-1a32 0x89b1a596 derived from the upstream source
